title: Project Open-Meteo ten-day and OpenWeather eight-plus-two capability honestly

gates.name: Host provider-capability and long-term session probes

verify: Establish claim-linked RED against current state: long-term entry assumes one ten-record provider shape and has no selected-provider capability proof for OpenWeather eight records plus two intentional empty positions.

With a selected-city date/timezone fixture, prove complete Open-Meteo data requires ten records and fills all ten dated positions starting today; fewer than ten keeps Main Display with the accepted unavailable message.

Prove complete OpenWeather data requires eight records, opens the same ten-position session, fills positions one through eight and leaves nine and ten dated but unavailable/empty without temperature or illustration; fewer than eight keeps Main Display with the accepted message.

Exercise Tomorrow and Day-after entry against both providers and prove they open the same capability-correct session. No position is synthesized, duplicated, borrowed from Open-Meteo or filled from another provider/cache partition.
Keep the existing 2x5 available-card presentation and shared exit flow as regression checks owned historically by W5; do not redesign them.
Use deterministic fixtures and resettable session state; no live provider, secret, emulator/device evidence or runtime PASS claim is permitted.
Closure later requires fresh /verify PASS and /red-verify semantic-pass for FT-004-AC-001, AC-002, AC-005 and AC-006 Revision-2 claims; scheduler promotion remains external.

purpose: Apply provider-specific daily completeness to the existing shared long-term session so Open-Meteo fills ten positions and OpenWeather honestly supplies eight plus two dated empty positions.
success_outcome: Deterministic host evidence proves provider-correct entry thresholds and one ten-position selected-city projection: Open-Meteo 10 filled, OpenWeather 8 filled plus 2 empty, with incomplete sets unavailable and no synthesis or cross-provider data.
anti_goals: Do not implement provider HTTP adapters, selection/key Settings, cache/history ownership or no-fallback dispatch already owned upstream.
Do not redesign the accepted 2x5 layout, available-card presentation, auto-close or gesture exit flow owned by terminal W5 evidence.
Do not demand ten records from OpenWeather, invent two provider records, hide the two positions, borrow Open-Meteo data or create provider-specific screens.
Do not add a plugin framework, new module, dependency or speculative forecast abstraction.

forbidden_scope: weather HTTP transport, adapter parsing, provider/key Settings and cache/history implementation
long-term layout/presentation/gesture redesign beyond regression preservation
synthetic/duplicated/cross-provider daily records or provider-specific screens
new modules, dependencies, plugin/DI/event infrastructure and live external calls
stop_conditions: Stop and ask the operator before changing Open-Meteo 10, OpenWeather 8+2, ten dated positions or the accepted unavailable message.
Stop and route to /spec-design if a new module, graph edge, public contract or state owner is required.
Stop and route to /feature-to-tasks FT-004 if task identity, tier, dependency, AC ownership or material scope must change.
Stop and return upstream to TASK-020 if normalized provider data cannot preserve required date/capability identity without adapter changes.

constraints: Forecast Sessions owns session entry/lifecycle; Weather Context owns normalized selected-provider daily data and capability metadata.
A complete selected-provider set is exactly 10 Open-Meteo records or 8 OpenWeather records. Both yield ten dated positions from selected-city today.
OpenWeather positions nine and ten are intentional unavailable/empty projections and do not invalidate a complete eight-record set.
No missing record or empty position is synthesized, copied, borrowed from another provider or filled from a mismatched cache/history partition.
Existing available-card presentation and shared exit flow remain unchanged; no hard write_boundary is declared beyond advisory files and semantic controls.
verification_targets: FT-004-AC-001 / REQ-010, REQ-026: provider-specific complete/incomplete entry from Tomorrow and Day-after.
FT-004-AC-002 / REQ-010, REQ-022: ten selected-city dated positions for both provider capabilities.
FT-004-AC-005 / REQ-010, REQ-026: fewer than provider threshold yields exact unavailable message and no session.
FT-004-AC-006 / REQ-010, REQ-026: Open-Meteo 10 filled versus OpenWeather 8 filled plus two empty without synthesis or cross-provider fill.
